# user-image

An image the user pasted into their message: a `User image · <mime>` label over
the picture. The picture is a `ViewerThumbnail` (`primitives/overlay/image-viewer`),
capped inline; clicking it opens the full-window viewer, where ← / → step through
the transcript's other images. Nothing expands inline.
